🇺🇸🇨🇳 U.S. NAVY BRINGS THE HEAT TO CHINA’S DOORSTEP

The U.S. Navy just made a big move in the Pacific, sailing straight into one of the most tense regions on Earth.

The aircraft carrier USS Nimitz and several powerful warships are now cruising through the West Philippine Sea, about 100 miles south of a disputed area called the Scarborough Shoal. 

That spot has been at the center of long fights between China and the Philippines over who really controls it.

Alongside the Nimitz are destroyers like the USS Gridley, USS Wayne E. Meyer, and USS Lenah Sutcliffe Higbee, plus the cruiser USS Princeton. Together, they form one of the most powerful naval groups in the world.

This isn’t just a regular patrol. U.S. commanders have reportedly ordered a “show of force” after China increased aggressive actions against Philippine and Taiwanese ships. 

There are even talks that the Marines could fire HIMARS rockets, like the ones used in Ukraine, near the shoal to prove the U.S. isn’t backing down.

The U.S. is standing by its allies, and it’s ready to remind everyone who still rules the waves.

Source: @MT_Anderson, U.S. INDOPACOM, @sentdefender

data.raw_text:
Mobile gaming news roundup (October 2025): New releases, Industry movements and more

🗓️ Week 1: October 01 to October 07

The first week of October 2025 delivered a mix of new releases, pre-registrations, and major announcements. Soccer Journey: Champion Squad, MiniRacer Mayhem, Dino War: Survival, and Endless Worlds launched globally, while INMOST confirmed its release for October 28.

Pre-registrations opened for Besiege and Kamen Rider DEFENSE WARRIORS, with NARUTO KAGE entering soft launch in select regions. Meanwhile, Monster Walk: Step Adventure began limited rollout, and Ragnarok Abyss was officially renamed from Project Abyss: Next Ragnarok.

On the announcement front, Talking Tom Cat Remaster was announced with upgraded visuals, and Supercent launched the RE:BOUND 2025 initiative. The week wrapped with Hello World showcased at PAX Australia and Magic Jigsaw Puzzles collaborating with Cut the Rope.

🗓️ Week 2: October 08 to October 14

Same story as the first week, we had a good number of launches. Sorry! World, My Om Nom, Disney Magic Match 3D, Ricochet Squad, and HIROZZ all launched globally. At the same time, Last Day GO entered early access, and Vampirio: Defend & Survive soft-launched in select regions.

Pre-registrations went live for CrossFire: Legends, joining upcoming titles like BLEACH: Soul Resonance and Secrets of Paradise, launching worldwide this November. WWE 2K25 Mobile also began soft launch testing under Netflix Games, while Football Manager 26 Touch and EA’s MySims titles were confirmed for Apple Arcade in November.

New projects made headlines with DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY, Dead Account: Two Blue Flames, and Tenkemo were officially announced, while Control Ultimate Edition was revealed for Apple platforms in early 2026. Rounding off the week, Reddit introduced in-app games, and NetEase issued DMCA takedowns for Destiny: Rising leaks.

🗓️ Week 3: October 15 to October 21

The third week of October 2025 had Hunters Origin debuting worldwide, while AWAKEN: AstralBlade arrived on iOS. Soft launches included Soul Land: Time Reversed, Sin Seed, and OverField, with Girls’ Frontline: Fire Control set for release.

Pre-registrations opened for MapleStory: Idle RPG, and several major releases were confirmed, including Sonic Rumble and Sword of Justice arriving in November, and Planet of Lana heading to mobile this December.

Lost Ark Mobile also began its closed beta phase, while Project Vampire started testing in the Philippines. The Sims Mobile shutdown was officially announced for January 2026, Football Manager 26 secured an official FIFA partnership, and SEGA Football Club Champions was delayed to early 2026.

Chinami Holic and Senran Kagura Project N were revealed for 2026, while My Talking Tom Friends 2 rolled out its Halloween update. The week wrapped with the GamingonPhone Awards 2025 in Bangkok, BGMI Esports’ transfer window opening, and the Subway Surfers x Among Us collaboration kicking off.

🗓️ Week 4: October 22 to October 28

The fourth week of October 2025 saw Awakenloop, Dawn Watch: Survival, and Dicefolk launched globally, and Ragnarok Twilight launching across Southeast Asia. Meanwhile, Angry Birds Match World soft-launched in Finland.

Pre-registrations went live for Legend of YMIR, Hero Seekers, and Duck Detective: Ghost Glamping, while Petit Planet and Heartopia announced upcoming closed beta tests. CABAL RED confirmed a November 25 launch, and Bluey’s Quest for the Gold Pen revealed its iOS release for December. Boat Game also opened sign-ups for its second Alpha test.

Outside of game launches, Netflix announced a Catan TV adaptation, MONOPOLY GO! Chat began regional testing in France, and Honor of Kings: World confirmed its Spring 2026 release window. Rememento: White Shadow suspended services ahead of a relaunch, Strinova launched in China, and Warrior Cats was revealed to be getting a mobile adaptation in 2027.

🗓️ Week 5: October 29 to October 31

The last three days didn’t leave us empty-handed, as we had several announcements to share. Billionaire Royale Club and Hill Climb Racing 3 both entered soft launch, while Waltz of the Wizard made its iOS debut.

OverField confirmed its global launch date for November 6, and Aniimo began recruiting players for its iOS technical test in the US. Monument Valley 3 announced its return to mobile this December. Supercell announced the shutdown of Squad Busters, with its final update arriving this December.

Meanwhile, Pokémon Masters EX revealed partial shutdown plans in select SEA regions, and UnGodly was officially postponed to Q1 2026. The Call of Duty Movie project gained traction with a confirmed writer and director, and Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super marked its UK premiere on BBC CBeebies.

If you have read until the end and found it useful, please feel free to reshare!

🔗https://t.co/34MCiw8DM2

Full Review of Lenskart Solutions Ltd IPO

I am Applying for Reasonable Listing Gains and Short Term Action as well Holding ✅

Pointers:
▫️Lenskart is India's Largest and Among Asia's Top Two Largest organised retailers of prescription eyeglasses

- Lenskart is India’s largest and fastest-growing eyewear company with about 5-7% Market Share

▫️It is a D2C Company that designs and sells a wide range of eyewear products under its own brands and sub-brands in India and in International markets across Southeast Asia, Japan, and the Middle East

- Company offered over 79,000 SKUs across frame portfolio in India. Company mostly cater to Mass and Mid Premium Eyewear markets in India

- Brands include Premium: John Jacobs and Owndays and Economy and Affordable Premium: Lenskart Air, Vincent Chase, hustlr, and Hooper Kids

▫️Lenskart has a Robust Omnichannel model wherein it has Website, Application and offline stores to serve its customers

- Mobile applications had more than 100 million downloads, Web traffic for the FY25 was 10.5 Cr Annual visitors

▫️Lenskart has Total 2,806 Stores. 2,137 in India and 669 Stores in International markets

- 2,311 Stores are CoCo Stores and rest 495 are Franchise based stores

- In FY25, Company conducted more than 1.3 Cr Eye tests in India and more than 25 lakh tests outside Indian in their Stores

- They Served more than 1.2 Cr Users in FY25 and sold more than 2.72 Cr Eyewear Units in the same period

- Same-Store Sales Growth was 15.7% and Same-Pincode Sales Growth was 20.5%

- About 60% Revenue comes from India and Rest 40% comes from markets such as Japan, Southeast Asia (Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Cambodia), the Middle East (United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia) and others

▫️Lenskart has developed Centralised supply chain & Manufacturing processes wherein they procure frames & lenses, does lens processes (Coating, Edging and Polishing) and ultimately Assembling lenses & frames at their Centralised Manufacturing Facilities

- About 70% of their prescription eyeglasses sold were manufactured in their own facilities

- There are four manufacturing facilities, one in Gurgaon, one in Bhiwadi, one in Singapore and one in Dubai. There is one more JV facility in China

- The Bhiwadi facility is amongst the top two vertically integrated centralised manufacturing facilities for prescription eyeglasses globally. It is 75% Automated with less manpower requirements

- Company is developing a new Greenfield facility in Hyderabad which will be much bigger than the size of Bhiwadi facility. Company is spending 1,500 Cr for Construction of this facility. Company has signed an MoU with Government of Telangana

▫️As of June, Company imports about 53% of its raw materials and finished goods from China, Particularly from its JV company Baofeng Framekart Technology Ltd

- Framekart does manufacturing in China (Particularly Frames) and supplies to Lenskart. It is 51% JV for Lenskart

▫️Lenskart focuses a lot on Technology, they have 491 technology team members who develops AI-enabled solutions such as Facial analysis and frame recommendation tools, computer vision platforms for store optimization

- Such Tech helps company to improve their Store Experience and gives them immense data for understanding the customer behaviour and buying patterns

▫️Lenskart has several subsidiaries and JVs to support their International operations and managing their Raw Materials as well as End Products requirements

- They Acquired Owndays Group in 2022, It is a major Japanese eyewear brand. Owndays targets the premium segment and this acquisition enabled Lenskart to expand their presence in 13 International markets

- Recent two Acquisitions: 1) Stellio Ventures, It owns Spanish popular eyewear brand "Meller" and 2) Quantduo Technologies: It is a technology company that will help Lenskart strengthen Tech Capabilities

▫️Objects of the Offer
Issue Size: 7,278 Cr, OFS: 5,128 Cr

Out of 2,150 Cr Fresh Issue,
1️⃣ For Setting up new CoCo Stores: 272.6 Cr

- Company will use these funds for opening 620 New Stores till November 2028

2️⃣ Lease Related Expenses for CoCo Stores: 591.4 Cr

3️⃣ Investment in Tech & Cloud infrastructure: 213.3 Cr

4️⃣ Marketing and Promotional Expenses: 320 Cr

5️⃣ For Inorganic acquisitions & GCP: 752 Cr

▫️Financials
Lenskart is Growing Steadily both in Indian and International Markets, Their Margins have significantly improved and are improving in FY26 also

Their Gross Profit Margins and Working Capital Days have also improved significantly

Balance Sheet is quality is also improving, Their TRs are coming down and debt has also decreased over the years. But overall it looks like a typical Startup type Balance Sheet

In FY25, Company generated about 1,230 Cr Operating Cash which is really solid. Startups generally burn a lot of cash whereas Lenskart generated good cash each year

▫️Valuation 
Lenskart is coming at FY25 Market cap/EBITDA: 71.3x
and FY25 Price to Sales: 10.5x

There is no listed direct peer of this company, Lenskart is 2.5x bigger than Titan Eye. There are only a few international listed peers of Lensakart such as EssilorLuxottica and Warby Parker but they can also be not compared due to difference in Scale and Style of operation

Let's see at what valuations does other Indian Consumer Tech Companies trade at

FY25 (M.Cap/EBITDA, Price to Sales)
Eternal (Zomato): 473x, 15.2x
Nykaa: 150x, 9x
Bluestone: 141x, 6.1x
Firstcry: 79x, 2.4x
Urban Company: NA, 19.8x
Ather Energy: NA, 11.7x
Paytm: NA, 12.1x

Lenskart: 71.3x, 10.5x

It is Clear after seeing the numbers that Lenskart is richly priced but definitely not overly priced when compared with other Consumer Tech Companies

People who are jumping after seeing PE of Lenskart have no idea about how to judge a Startup company which recently got profitable. One should only judge such companies on EV/EBITDA (If EBITDA is +ve), on Price to Sales or on Market Cap to EBITDA

There is other income in FY25 PAT of Lenskart, but we shouldn't even consider the PAT number, Only consider EBITDA and Sales number to value such a company

If we estimate a 25% Sales Growth for Lenskart in FY26, Company can post Revenue of about 8,700 Cr and EBITDA of 1,400-1,500 Cr

On that basis, Lenskart is coming at about 8x FY26E Price to Sales and about 48x FY26E M.Cap to EBITDA

Valuing Lenskart at 10x FY26 Price to Sales and 60x FY26 M.Cap to EBITDA, The Upside Visibility is about 25%

Valuations could have been at least 15% Lower to make this counter a very attractive deal. Price is Rich but not very Expensive

▫️Other Pointers:
- Promoters are Very Solid, Peyush Bansal has Good expertise in Technology and has vast experience
- Anchor Book was Top Notch
- Demand is Decent

- The Question of why Peyush Bansal got shares at ₹52 in July 2025 and now IPO is coming at ₹402, Is actually very naive. Such Practices are common in Startup companies where founders make agreements with Private Equities and Funds in early years to get shares at lower prices in future at certain time. Just think once, Are investors like SoftBank and Kedaara Capital foolish to sell shares at ₹52 to Peyush and not instead offloading them in OFS? There are certain processes and commitments which goes behind every decision

▫️Risk Factors
- High Dependency on China for Raw materials and Frames. Company is pushing very Hard for Localisation but it won't be easy to overcome this Risk in near future
- The Eyewear Market is Highly Fragmented and there is so much competition from unorganised players
- In 2022, ED had initiated an inquiry under FEMA Act for certain information and documents
- There are Criminal Proceedings against the Company (1), Promoters (4) and Directors (8) and also multiple Tax Proceedings against the Company and subsidiaries

▫️Conclusion
Lenskart is a true Global Indian Company which is solving a simple yet important problem of vision impairment. The way this company has expanded its footprint in India and outside India in 15 years is really commendable

The Indian organised retail market for eyewear is expected to grow at 22-28% CAGR for next few years. Current market share of Retail Organised is just 24%

Japanese markets are matured which won't grow at much pace but Middle East and Southeast Asia are expected to grow at Healthy Steady Pace

Lenskart's customer Repeat Ratio is very Healthy and they offer Gold Memberships to intrigue consumers to go with multiple eyewear pairs and push them to come back again at Lenskart in future by giving them attractive offers (Almost 70% Transacting users were Gold Members in FY25)

This Company can really Grow Well, It will be interesting to see the execution with each passing quarter. Will closely track this business

I am Applying for Listing Gains and Short Term. I will take holding decisions based on the Execution of the company and management commentary

Such Companies perform really well in the markets if they keep growing at healthy pace and does opposite if sales growth comes down, Let's see if it becomes Zomato or Firstcry!

Overall a Super High Quality Consumer Tech Business with Solid Growth Potential is coming at Reasonable Valuations

It is a Complete Organic and Genuine Review, So Don't Cry in Comments by claiming it as a Promotional Post. Neither in my life have I taken money for the Review nor will I take it in future. Check my profile, I have Reviewed 100+ IPOs till now and I only share Genuine Stuff
